Phir us tezi mein daurte hue pattharon ke saath unke na'al ka takrana aur us ragar se aag ki chingariyan urna, phir subh ke waqt dushman par unka chapa marna aur dushmanan-e-Rabb ko teh-o-bala karna. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yahi aadat-e-mubarak thi ke dushman ki kisi basti par aap jate to wahan raat ko thehar kar kaan laga kar sunte, agar azan ki awaz aa gayi to aap ruk jate, na aati to lashkar ko hukum dete ke bazan bol dein. Phir un ghoron ka gard-o-ghubar urana aur un sab ka dushmanon ke darmiyan ghus jana, in sab cheezon ki qasam kha kar phir mazmoon shuru hota hai.

Hazrat Abdullah se marvi hai ke Wal-Aadiyati se murad oont hain. Hazrat Ali bhi yahi farmate hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul ke is se murad ghore hain. Jab Hazrat Ali ko maloom hua to aap ne farmaya ghore hamare Badr wale din thay hi kab? Yeh to us chotay lashkar mein thay jo bheja gaya tha. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) ek martaba Khatim mein baithe hue thay ke ek shakhs ne aa kar is aayat ki tafsir pochi to aap ne farmaya is se murad mujahideen ke ghore hain jo ba-waqt-e-jihad dushmanon par dhawa bolte hain, phir raat ke waqt yeh ghur-sawar mujahid apne camp mein aa kar khane pakane ke liye aag jalate hain. Woh yeh poch kar Hazrat Ali ke paas gaya, aap us waqt Zamzam ka pani logon ko pila rahe thay. Us ne aap se bhi yahi sawal kiya. Aap ne farmaya mujh se pehle kisi aur se bhi tum ne pocha hai? Kaha haan Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se pocha hai to unhon ne farmaya mujahideen ke ghore hain jo Allah ki raah mein dhawa bolen. Hazrat Ali ne farmaya jana zara unhein mere paas bulana. Jab woh aa gaye to Hazrat Ali ne farmaya tumhein maloom nahin aur tum logon ko fatway de rahe ho? Allah ki qasam pehla ghazwa Islam mein Badr ka hua, is larai mein hamare sath sirf do ghore thay, ek shakhs Hazrat Zubair (R.A) ka, dusra Hazrat Miqdad (R.A) ka, to Aadiyati Zabha yeh kaise ho sakte hain? Is se murad to Arafat se Muzdalifa ki taraf jane wale aur phir Muzdalifa se Mina ki taraf jane wale hain. Hazrat Abdullah farmate hain yeh sun kar main ne apne agle qaul se ruju kar liya aur Hazrat Ali ne jo farmaya tha wahi kehne laga. Muzdalifa mein pohanch kar haaji bhi apni handiya roti ke liye aag sulgate hain. Gharz Hazrat Ali ka farman yeh hua ke is se murad oont hain aur yahi qaul ek jamaat ka hai jin mein Ibrahim, Ubaid bin Umair waghera hain aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se ghore marvi hain. Mujahid, Ikrama, Atta, Qatada aur Zahhak bhi yahi kehte hain aur Imam Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain. Balkay Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas aur Hazrat Atta se marvi hai ke Zabha yani hanpna kisi janwar ke liye nahin hota siwaye ghore aur kutte ke. Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain un ke munh se hanpte hue jo aawaz 'ah ah' ki nikalti hai yahi Zabha hai. Aur dusre jumlay ke ek to ma'ani yeh kiye gaye hain ke un ghoron ki tapon ka pathar se takra kar aag paida karna aur dusre ma'ani yeh bhi kiye gaye hain ke un ke sawaron ka larai ki aag ko bharkana aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke larai mein makr-o-dhoka karna aur yeh bhi marvi hai ke raton ko apni qayam-gah par pohanch kar aag roshan karna aur Muzdalifa mein haajiyon ka ba'ad az maghrib pohanch kar aag jalana. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain mere nazdeek sab se zyada theek qaul yahi hai ke ghoron ki tapon aur sumon ka pathar se ragar kha kar aag paida karna, phir subh ke waqt mujahideen ka dushmanon par achanak toot parna. Aur jin sahiban ne is se murad oont liye hain woh farmate hain is se murad Muzdalifa se Mina ki taraf subh ko jana hai. Phir yeh sab kehte hain ke phir un ka jis makan mein yeh utre hain khwah jihad mein hon khwah hajj mein ghubar urana, phir un mujahideen ka kuffar ki faujon mein mardana ghus jana aur chirte pharte marte pacharte un ke beech lashkar mein pohanch jana aur yeh bhi murad ho sakti hai ke sab jama ho kar us jagah darmiyan mein aa jate hain to is surat mein 'Jam'an' haal muakkad hone ki wajah se mansoob hoga. Abu Bakr Bazzar mein is jagah ek ghareeb hadith hai jis mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek lashkar bheja tha, ek mahina guzar gaya lekin us ki koi khabar na aayi, is par yeh aayatein utrin aur us lashkar ki Allah Ta'ala ne khabar di ke un ke ghore hanpte hue tez chaal se gaye, un ke sumon ki takkar se chingariyan ur rahi thin, unhon ne subh hi subh dushmanon par poori yalghar ke sath hamla kar diya, un ki tapon se gard ur rahi thi, phir ghalib aa kar sab jama ho kar baith gaye. In qasmon ke ba'ad ab woh mazmoon bayan ho raha hai jis par qasmein khayi gayi thin ke insaan apne Rabb ki nematon ka qadardan nahin. Agar koi dukh dard kisi waqt aa gaya hai to woh to bakhoobi yaad rakhta hai lekin Allah Ta'ala ki hazarha nematein jo hain sab ko bhulaye hue hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki hadith mein hai ke 'Kanood' woh hai jo tanha khaye, ghulamon ko mare aur aasaan sulook na kare, is ki isnaad zaeef hai. Phir farmaya Allah is par shahid hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh khud is baat par apna gawah aap hai, is ki nashukri is ke af'aal-o-aqwal se saaf zahir hai jaise aur jagah hai 'Shahideen-e-ala anfusihim bil-kufr' yani mushrikeen se Allah Ta'ala ki masjidon ki aabadi nahin ho sakti jabke yeh apne kufr ke aap gawah hain. Phir farmaya yeh maal ki chahat mein bara sakht hai yani ise maal ki be-had mohabbat hai aur yeh bhi ma'ani hain ke is ki mohabbat mein phans kar hamari raah mein dene se ji churata aur bukhl karta hai. Phir Parwardigar-e-Aalam ise duniya se be-raghbat karne aur aakhirat ki taraf mutawajja karne ke liye farma raha hai ke kya insaan ko yeh maloom nahin ke ek waqt woh aa raha hai ke jab tamam murday qabron se nikal kharay honge aur jo kuch baatein chupi lagi hui thin sab zahir ho jayengi. Sun lo un ka Rabb un ke tamam kamon se ba-khabar hai aur har ek amal ka badla poora poora dene wala hai, ek zarray ke barabar zulm woh rawa nahin rakhta aur na rakhega.

Surah Al-Adiyat ki tafsir Allah ke fazl-o-ehsan se khatam hui, falhamdulillah.

Phir farmaya yeh maal ki chahat mein bara sakht hai yani ise maal ki be-had mohabbat hai aur yeh bhi ma'ani hain ke is ki mohabbat mein phans kar hamari raah mein dene se ji churata aur bukhl karta hai. Phir Parwardigar-e-Aalam ise duniya se be-raghbat karne aur aakhirat ki taraf mutawajja karne ke liye farma raha hai ke kya insaan ko yeh maloom nahin ke ek waqt woh aa raha hai ke jab tamam murday qabron se nikal kharay honge aur jo kuch baatein chupi lagi hui thin sab zahir ho jayengi. Sun lo un ka Rabb un ke tamam kamon se ba-khabar hai aur har ek amal ka badla poora poora dene wala hai, ek zarray ke barabar zulm woh rawa nahin rakhta aur na rakhega.

Surah Al-Adiyat ki tafsir Allah ke fazl-o-ehsan se khatam hui, falhamdulillah.

Insaan ka nafsiyati tajziya: Mujahideen ke ghore jabke Allah ki raah mein jihad ke liye haanpte aur hin-hate hue daurte hain, unki Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala qasam khata hai. Phir us tezi mein daurte hue pattharon ke saath unke na'al ka takrana aur us ragar se aag ki chingariyan urna, phir subh ke waqt dushman par unka chapa marna aur dushmanan-e-Rabb ko teh-o-bala karna. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yahi aadat-e-mubarak thi ke dushman ki kisi basti par aap jate to wahan raat ko thehar kar kaan laga kar sunte, agar azan ki awaz aa gayi to aap ruk jate, na aati to lashkar ko hukum dete ke bazan bol dein. Phir un ghoron ka gard-o-ghubar urana aur un sab ka dushmanon ke darmiyan ghus jana, in sab cheezon ki qasam kha kar phir mazmoon shuru hota hai.

Hazrat Abdullah se marvi hai ke Wal-Aadiyati se murad oont hain. Hazrat Ali bhi yahi farmate hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul ke is se murad ghore hain. Jab Hazrat Ali ko maloom hua to aap ne farmaya ghore hamare Badr wale din thay hi kab? Yeh to us chotay lashkar mein thay jo bheja gaya tha. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) ek martaba Khatim mein baithe hue thay ke ek shakhs ne aa kar is aayat ki tafsir pochi to aap ne farmaya is se murad mujahideen ke ghore hain jo ba-waqt-e-jihad dushmanon par dhawa bolte hain, phir raat ke waqt yeh ghur-sawar mujahid apne camp mein aa kar khane pakane ke liye aag jalate hain. Woh yeh poch kar Hazrat Ali ke paas gaya, aap us waqt Zamzam ka pani logon ko pila rahe thay. Us ne aap se bhi yahi sawal kiya. Aap ne farmaya mujh se pehle kisi aur se bhi tum ne pocha hai? Kaha haan Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se pocha hai to unhon ne farmaya mujahideen ke ghore hain jo Allah ki raah mein dhawa bolen. Hazrat Ali ne farmaya jana zara unhein mere paas bulana. Jab woh aa gaye to Hazrat Ali ne farmaya tumhein maloom nahin aur tum logon ko fatway de rahe ho? Allah ki qasam pehla ghazwa Islam mein Badr ka hua, is larai mein hamare sath sirf do ghore thay, ek shakhs Hazrat Zubair (R.A) ka, dusra Hazrat Miqdad (R.A) ka, to Aadiyati Zabha yeh kaise ho sakte hain? Is se murad to Arafat se Muzdalifa ki taraf jane wale aur phir Muzdalifa se Mina ki taraf jane wale hain. Hazrat Abdullah farmate hain yeh sun kar main ne apne agle qaul se ruju kar liya aur Hazrat Ali ne jo farmaya tha wahi kehne laga. Muzdalifa mein pohanch kar haaji bhi apni handiya roti ke liye aag sulgate hain. Gharz Hazrat Ali ka farman yeh hua ke is se murad oont hain aur yahi qaul ek jamaat ka hai jin mein Ibrahim, Ubaid bin Umair waghera hain aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se ghore marvi hain. Mujahid, Ikrama, Atta, Qatada aur Zahhak bhi yahi kehte hain aur Imam Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain. Balkay Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas aur Hazrat Atta se marvi hai ke Zabha yani hanpna kisi janwar ke liye nahin hota siwaye ghore aur kutte ke. Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain un ke munh se hanpte hue jo aawaz 'ah ah' ki nikalti hai yahi Zabha hai. Aur dusre jumlay ke ek to ma'ani yeh kiye gaye hain ke un ghoron ki tapon ka pathar se takra kar aag paida karna aur dusre ma'ani yeh bhi kiye gaye hain ke un ke sawaron ka larai ki aag ko bharkana aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke larai mein makr-o-dhoka karna aur yeh bhi marvi hai ke raton ko apni qayam-gah par pohanch kar aag roshan karna aur Muzdalifa mein haajiyon ka ba'ad az maghrib pohanch kar aag jalana. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain mere nazdeek sab se zyada theek qaul yahi hai ke ghoron ki tapon aur sumon ka pathar se ragar kha kar aag paida karna, phir subh ke waqt mujahideen ka dushmanon par achanak toot parna. Aur jin sahiban ne is se murad oont liye hain woh farmate hain is se murad Muzdalifa se Mina ki taraf subh ko jana hai. Phir yeh sab kehte hain ke phir un ka jis makan mein yeh utre hain khwah jihad mein hon khwah hajj mein ghubar urana, phir un mujahideen ka kuffar ki faujon mein mardana ghus jana aur chirte pharte marte pacharte un ke beech lashkar mein pohanch jana aur yeh bhi murad ho sakti hai ke sab jama ho kar us jagah darmiyan mein aa jate hain to is surat mein 'Jam'an' haal muakkad hone ki wajah se mansoob hoga.
